# ATS company directory

`directory.json.gz` maps company names and board slugs to the company's own job board (Workday, Oracle, Greenhouse,
Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, SuccessFactors, iCIMS, Darwinbox, Keka, ...). It is generated by
`scripts/build_ats_directory.py` from these MIT-licensed open datasets:

- **kalil0321/ats-scrapers**, `ats-companies/*.csv`. Copyright (c) 2026 Kalil Bouzigues. MIT License.
  https://github.com/kalil0321/ats-scrapers
- **Feashliaa/job-board-aggregator** (Riley Dorrington), `data/*_companies.json`. MIT License.
  https://github.com/Feashliaa/job-board-aggregator

`hub/ats_directory.py` reads it; `hub/careerops.py` scans the boards the vendored career-ops providers support.
